item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Halsey + Machine Gun Kelly @ Crypto.com Arena 2022-02-10
item.description:
1st night Bud Light Super Bowl Music, here are some of my original notes.

For those of us who don't care about football probably don't care about bad pop music or even worse beer either but I am posting some anyways with the Bud Light Super Bowl Music fest which took place 3 nights in a row at the former Staples Center in downtown Los Angeles. Opening night 1 was Machine Gun Kelly followed by Halsey. I know she hadn't played in awhile but was clearly trying too hard. At least the pyro was fun.

Poorly managed, overpriced and overbrokered which led to a crash on the secondary with me getting into the Premier level for this show for $6.37
